0022600097.text: The Raptors (1-0) visit the Wizards (1-0) in a matchup of unbeaten teams, with Toronto sitting second in the Atlantic, half a game back, and fourth in the East while Washington is second in the Southeast and fifth in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, and Toronto won the last meeting 134-125 in Washington on February 28, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series the Raptors took 2-1. Toronto will be without Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Felix Okpara is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision.
